system.description:
Uses your Strength modifier in place of your Dexterity modifier for Reflex Defense.

Reduces speed by 5 feet and imposes a -2 Armor Check Penalty to Acrobatics, Athletics, Endurance, Initiative and Stealth. Has 1 Upgrade Point. Without Armor Proficiency you gain none of this armor's benefits; its penalties still apply.

Beskar'gam Upgrade (Mandalorians only): Damage Reduction 2.
